item.title: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt: the situation
item.description:
Youth protests continue in Delhi targeting Prime Minister Narendra Modi, while a man forced his way into the Chhattisgarh chief minister's house and was detained after clashes with police. A landmine explosion near the Line of Control in Azad Kashmir killed four men and a separate explosion near the LoC in Poonch raised casualty fears, and a teenager died after his vehicle plunged off a road in Rajouri. The Director General of Police in Kashmir directed intensified intelligence-led operations and juveniles fled a safety home in Chhattisgarh, where human-elephant conflict also killed a teenager. The conflict produced 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
